sec.title: September 6 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 870)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 6** across two metropolitan crime investigations on *Mr. District Attorney* for Bristol-Myers (telltale button homicide in 1944; hidden gambling wire office in 1950), Prime Minister Winston Churchill's landmark Harvard University address on Anglo-American unity (1943), French civil rights docudrama on *We Came This Way* (1945), Damon Runyon's humorous Broadway tale *Cemetery Bait* (1949), and legal satire on BBC Radio 4's *Brothers in Law* (1972).
All episode titles maintain pure canonical naming, with credited performers, conductors, and story details recorded in the narrative description:
